snapshot.text: Universal social insurance through the CCSS, long a regional model, now strained by long waiting lists and specialist shortages. The new government kept the CCSS leadership and changed the health ministry; a CCSS plan aims to cut waiting lists by 2030.

priorities.title: Waiting lists
priorities.text: A CCSS plan to 2030 to reduce waiting lists; 56,000 people left the list in 2026.

priorities.title: Private capacity
priorities.text: The private sector offered 380 beds and 61 operating rooms to help clear waiting lists.
